name: stock-opportunity-lab
description: A-share opportunity screening, buy planning, and backtesting for web and Tauri desktop.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,wechat -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:wechat"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:sidecar && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.prod.conf.json
scripts.desktop:build:debug: npm run desktop:sidecar && tauri build --debug --config src-tauri/tauri.prod.conf.json
scripts.desktop:release: npm run desktop:sidecar && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.desktop:release:debug: npm run desktop:sidecar && tauri build --debug --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:desktop:web: cross-env VITE_STOCK_LAB_DESKTOP=true npm --prefix frontend run build
